implementation.adapter_policy: Use the maintained ORCDF response-graph semantics through a local split-safe runner; no raw prerequisite evidence is supplied as a model graph.

data_protocol.held_out_student_policy: Neutral zero-history embedding: response-graph construction uses train rows only, and validation/test student base embeddings are fixed to zero with no calibration from held-out responses.
data_protocol.test_evaluation_policy: One final test evaluation only after the validation-selected epoch is frozen; a local ledger blocks an accidental second evaluation.

response_graph.student_exercise_edges: Only retained train rows; separate right and wrong relations; repeated student-exercise rows are coalesced as weighted adjacency entries by the reference implementation.
response_graph.exercise_topic_edges: The frozen 624 by 40 Topic Q-matrix from JUNYI_MID_MODEL_V1.
response_graph.prerequisite_edges: Not used. Raw prerequisite evidence is neither a Published Graph nor an ORCDF input in this experiment.

training.optimization_unit: one full retained-train split step per epoch; required because the reference ORCDF contrastive objective is graph-global and this CPU-only run must not silently substitute a sampled loss
